question.text: A bandwidth of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn><mo> </mo><mi>MHz</mi></math> is available for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>.</mo><mi>M</mi><mo>.</mo></math> transmission. If the maximum audio signal frequency used for modulating the carrier wave is not to exceed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kHz</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The number of stations that can be broadcasted within this band simultaneously without interfering with each other will be __________.
